arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Divine Lance's{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_30} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Movement Speed bonus.

Current Bonus: {c_number}[SF_29 * SF_30 * 100|%x|]{/c}

{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} flurries, stabbing {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} additional times and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_FLURRY_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage each.

Killing {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} increases its Attack Speed by {c_number}[{SF_18} * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_19} * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Zealot{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} now stabs with {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} additional spears in a wider area, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_TRIDENT_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage each and has {c_number}[{SF_21} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.

Throw {c_important}Divine Lance{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:PROJECTILE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage to the first enemy hit and bursting for an additional {c_number}{payload:PROJECTILE_BURST_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.

The first time an enemy is hit by a {c_important}Divine Lance{/c}, they are impaled and dragged with it.
Successive hits on the same target with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} deal {c_number}[SF_37 * 100]%{/c} more damage up to {c_number}[SF_38 * 100]%{/c}.

{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_40} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. 

Double this bonus against {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.
Killing enemies with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} reduces the cost of your next {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} by {c_number}[SF_41 * 100]%{/c} up to {c_number}[SF_42 * 100]%{/c}
